svg.title: Circular and radial phylogenies (synthetic)
svg.desc: A karyon sheet of 4 panels in 2 columns: panel A, Outward calendar radii with categorical and continuous trait rings; panel B, A partial sweep keeps room for annotation and a collapsed clade; panel C, The same dated topology points towards a controlled central gap; panel D, Branch counts replace lengths and every tip reaches one circumference.
